Transformed complex nested data tables into stacked card layouts for mobile interfaces.[cite: 1]
development: Built a hybrid SSR/CSR frontend utilizing Next.js 16 App Router and React 19.[cite: 1]
Developed a robust backend with Express 5 and MongoDB, enforcing compound unique indexes.[cite: 1]
Integrated an Axios interceptor-driven HTTP client for automatic 401 detection and transparent request retries.[cite: 1]
features: Multi-tenant shops with per-shop data isolation[cite: 1]
AI Knowledge Base with document text extraction[cite: 1]
Transaction Engine for purchases and sales[cite: 1]

caseStudy.overview: CloudKitchen Group ran 5 virtual brands on scattered tools. SmartByte centralized menu management, order routing, and profitability analytics into one platform.

research: Mapped order flows across every delivery app and brand
